name: southriver_web_composer
_data_comment: South River is a no-backend shell: "local" makes every composed SDK read the host-owned data/ folder (theme, team, stockists, products, about, legal) through base_sdk's server-only reader and hides base's backend-only surface. See data/README.md and base/nextjs/docs/site-data.md in RokctAI/core.
description: Active Next.js SDK list for the southriver-web shell (composed by The-Rokct-Protocol core/utils/nextjs/sdk_composer.py)
_comment: The shell's own composition. South River is a client site, and the protocol registry holds products, not clients (Ray, 2026-10-31: no per-client compose templates), so .rokct/config/app_type names no registry template and this committed file IS the composition: `scripts/compose.sh refresh` re-pins it from the SDK repos and leaves it as committed; .rokct/lock.json records the same pins plus each SDK's commit and cache content hash. The kernel (telemetry_sdk, base_sdk) and corporate_sdk as the home SDK - the home of every local-data site, which draws the whole page from data/. No auth_sdk: there is no backend to sign in to.

sdks.name: telemetry_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of telemetry/nextjs/install.py at core@557517e, re-pinned by `scripts/compose.sh refresh`; required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate.
sdks._comment: Mandatory in every Next.js composition (SDK_ECOSYSTEM.md hard invariant 9): the delivery-policy seam owner, always first.

sdks.name: base_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of base/nextjs/install.py at core@557517e, re-pinned by `scripts/compose.sh refresh`; required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate.
sdks._comment: The platform kernel: app/services/base, the landing host and its registries, the admin and manager shells, and (1.35.0+) the lib/site-data reader and generate.mjs bundler behind this shell's local data mode. Every other Next.js SDK 'requires' files it installs.

sdks.name: corporate_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of corporate/nextjs/install.py at corporate@1d28d71, re-pinned by `scripts/compose.sh refresh`; required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate.
sdks._comment: The home SDK (corporate_sdk >= 1.4.0, the home of every local-data site): its manifest's "home" block owns app/page.tsx (a redirect to /landing) and fills base_sdk's landing registries from data/ - theme.json, site.json, sections.json, pricing.json, order.json and site.css; plus, as everywhere, the company pages (app/legal, app/about, app/team) from data/. Listed directly after base_sdk.
